sandboxLease.what: A sandbox lease from this task’s earlier run

teardown.what: A sandbox cleanup from this task’s earlier run

sandboxCreation.what: A sandbox this task’s earlier run was creating

runtimeControl.what: A workspace service change from this task’s earlier run

finalize.what: A workspace save from this task’s earlier run

finalizer.what: The result handling of this task’s earlier run

cleanup.what: The cleanup of this task’s earlier run

default.what: A resource from this task’s earlier run

controller.waiting: This run’s previous server was recorded before Paperclip stored which host it ran on, so Paperclip can’t verify that it stopped. The run’s saved state is kept.

confirmQuestion: How did you confirm that the previous server stopped?
confirmPlaceholder: For example: the old server container was replaced and is no longer running.

ownerGone.waiting: {{what}} was recorded before Paperclip stored which server held it, so Paperclip can’t verify that the server stopped. It stays reserved until then.

notRecoveredYet: Saved work is not recovered yet. The agent’s result is saved.

stop.waiting: The previous server stopped while it was saving this task’s files, and Paperclip can’t verify that it stopped. The agent’s result is saved.
stop.waitingConfirm: Paperclip is waiting to confirm that the previous server stopped.
stop.question: How did you confirm that the previous server and its file copy stopped?
stop.placeholder: For example: the old server process exited and was not restarted.
stop.notAccepted: The confirmation was not accepted. Refresh the task and try again.

source.notInspected: Paperclip can’t check the saved files’ source here because the run recorded too many sources.
source.ambiguous: Paperclip can’t confirm that this run alone used the sandbox that holds the saved files.
source.unverified: Paperclip can’t verify the saved files’ recorded source ({{code}}).

errors.changed: File recovery changed. Inspect its current status before requesting recovery.
errors.sourceNotVerified: The saved files’ source could not be verified.
errors.accountChanged: Your account changed. Refresh before requesting file recovery.
errors.previousNotConfirmed: The previous failed recovery is not confirmed. Check its status before trying again.
errors.couldNotSave: The recovery request could not be saved in this browser. No request was sent.
errors.ackNotConfirmed: The recovery acknowledgement could not be confirmed.
errors.requestCouldNotConfirm: The recovery request could not be confirmed. Check its status before trying again; the saved request will be reused.
errors.replaced: This file recovery was replaced. Showing the task’s current recovery.
errors.noneConfirmed: No recovery request is confirmed yet. Trying again will reuse the saved request.

retained.saved: Saved files recovered. Task recovery is still being checked.
retained.diskFull: The sandbox disk was full when Paperclip saved the files. Free space, then use Retry to save them and finish the task.
retained.gitInProgress: A Git operation was still in progress when Paperclip saved the files. Finish or abort it, then use Retry to save them and finish the task.
retained.failedReceipt: File recovery has not finished. The saved source remains protected.
retained.restoring: Recovering saved files. Work remains paused until recovery is verified.
retained.waiting: File recovery is queued. Waiting for verified saved files.
retained.needsRecovery: The saved files need recovery before work can continue.
retained.couldNotInspect: File recovery could not be inspected. Check its status again.
retained.notFinished: File recovery has not finished. The saved files remain protected and are not applied.
retained.doesNotApply: Paperclip does not apply files it can’t verify.
retained.replaced: This file recovery was replaced. Check its status to show the task’s current recovery.
retained.accessError: Task access could not be checked. Refresh before requesting file recovery.
retained.boardMemberCan: A board member with task access can request file recovery.
